LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectPool: Shared — any capable colonist may use it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectPoolDisabled: Unassigned — shared use is turned off in mod settings.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.InspectEmpty: Empty — put an outfit on it.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SetWorkTypeDesc:
This stand dresses for: {0} ({1}).

Whoever uses it changes into the outfit before starting automatic work of those kinds in this room, and changes back when they leave.

This switch also decides which mod's owner control the stand shows when another outfit-stand mod is installed: in service, Shift Change's; not used, the other mod's.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.WorkTypesExplainer: Ticked kinds of work, done in this room, trigger a change into this stand's outfit:
LanguageData.ShiftChange.FullChangeDesc:
Normally a pawn keeps whatever this stand's kit does not conflict with, so the uniform goes on over their own clothes.

With this on they undress completely and wear only what the stand holds — right for a sauna robe or a swimsuit, and slower in both directions, since every garment is taken off and put back on.

Everything their own clothes were providing comes off with them — warmth, armor, any bonuses those garments carried. They have exactly what the stand holds and nothing more.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.RoomReadsAs: the game reads this room as: {0}
LanguageData.ShiftChange.NoRoomRole: this spot is not in a roled room
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDesc: Reserve this stand for one colonist.\n\nLeave it unassigned and it is shared: any colonist about to do {0} in this room may use whichever stand is free. A kitchen therefore needs one stand per cook working at once, not one per cook.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescNoPool: Reserve this stand for one colonist.\n\nShared use of unassigned stands is turned off in mod settings, so only an assigned owner will change at this stand for {0}.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AssignDescNoWork: Reserve this stand for one colonist. It has no work type yet — either put it in a room with a role, or set one manually.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackDesc:
Cancel this colonist's orders and send them to {STAND} to change out of their work outfit.

Use this when a raid or emergency starts: they will not change back on their own while the map is under threat.

They keep working in this room in their own clothes, and will not put the outfit back on until they have left the room and returned. Drafting them clears that straight away.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.ChangeBackUnavailable: This colonist cannot change right now.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.SettingPoolUnassignedDesc: When on, an outfit stand with no assigned owner, standing in a work room, may be used by any colonist capable of that room's work.\n\nWhen off, only stands explicitly assigned to a colonist ever dress anyone — every unassigned stand behaves exactly like vanilla furniture.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AllowRemovingDesc: Shift Change: leave this off. Colonists stock the stand either way, and changing into its outfit ignores this setting completely — shift changes work with it off. Turning it on exposes the stand's contents to every colonist's outfit optimizer, which may simply take the uniform and wear it as everyday clothes.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.AllowRemovingDisabled: In service for shift changes, which keeps this off: turned on, the stand's contents are exposed to every colonist's outfit optimizer, and an assigned owner does not protect them.\n\nTo let haulers empty the stand, set it to 'Not used for shift changes' first.
LanguageData.ShiftChange.Faulted: Shift Change hit repeated errors and has stopped changing colonists for this game. Outfit stands still work as ordinary furniture. Loading a save will start it again; the details are in the dev log.
